overview: Three cross-reference sheets (1940-42): conflicting Bolivian reports on Japanese tin smelters, suspected diversion of tin nominally shipped to New York on Japanese vessels, and a Coordinator of Information report linking tin acquisition to Japanese aircraft production.

people.name: Jenkins
people.role: Official in Bolivia associated with the referenced despatch

people.name: Patton
people.role: Official in Singapore associated with the referenced telegram

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on tin smelters in Japan
subfiles.about: Cross-reference to a despatch requesting information about tin smelters in Japan because reports received in Bolivia were conflicting.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a 1940 Bolivia despatch seeking clarity on conflicting reports of Japanese tin smelters.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on suspected diversion of tin shipments to Japan
subfiles.about: Cross-reference to a telegram requesting data on tin arriving in New York aboard Japanese vessels amid suspicion that shipments were being diverted to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a 1940 telegram suspecting tin nominally shipped to New York on Japanese vessels was diverted to Japan.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on tin acquisition and Japanese aircraft production
subfiles.about: Cross-reference to a letter submitting a report on the relationship between Japanese tin acquisition and aircraft production.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a 1942 report, 'The Relation of Tin Acquisition to Airplane Production in Japan.'

interest: Tracks Japan's tin smelting capacity, suspected shipment diversion, and tin's link to Japanese aircraft production, 1940-42.
